title: First road trip in a new truck
body: Just got my new Ford F150 a couple of weeks ago and finally took it on a proper road trip. Felt a bit nervous at first, mostly about how it would handle the long haul. We drove from the farm to the coast and it just felt great. The handling is much smoother than my old rig, and the fuel economy is surprisingly decent. It's a real improvement for hauling feed and getting around the county.

subject: building a first emergency fund
title: My first emergency fund strategy worked
body: Trying to build that first emergency fund as a single dad felt impossible at first. I started by setting a super small, achievable goal instead of aiming for a huge number right away. I focused on saving $100 a month consistently, no matter what. That small, steady amount built momentum for me. Now I have a solid starting base and I feel way more confident about tackling bigger financial goals.
